The '''High Minister''' was the title of the leader of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tar Morden]], a neutral trade world during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Transfer of Power}}</ref>
